item.title: The most revealing moment in OpenAI's Data Agent launch this morning wasn't the demo. It was the Q&A. Almost nobody asked about the agent. They asked: – How do you handle the setup
item.description:
The most revealing moment in OpenAI's Data Agent launch this morning wasn't the demo. It was the Q&A. Almost nobody asked about the agent. They asked: – How do you handle the setup underneath — context, data quality, governance, accuracy? – How much of your data team's time now goes to reviewing analyses run by people who don't know the mechanics beneath them? – How do you validate that the agent returns reproducible logic across self-service queries? – How do you keep the semantic layer current as the business changes?
